Welcome to my blog! Here I share data science projects, tutorials, and things I've learned while working with different datasets.

## Data Science Projects

### BYU Basketball: How Have Rosters Changed Across Coaching Eras?

An exploration of BYU men's basketball rosters from 2005–2006 through 2026–2027. Using Python, BeautifulSoup, and pandas, I collected and analyzed player data to compare roster heights, hometown geography, and international representation across three head coaches.

[Read the BYU Basketball Roster Analysis](posts/byu-roster-analysis.qmd)

## Tutorials

### Identifying Basketball Possessions from NBA Play-by-Play Data

A Python tutorial exploring how raw NBA play-by-play events can be grouped into individual possessions. I explain the process of identifying possession-ending events and transforming event-level data into a more useful structure for basketball analysis.

[Read the NBA Possessions Tutorial](posts/nba-possessions.qmd)
